sermon.title: The Great Flood — December 20, 2020
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer walks through the great flood sequentially: long, corrupt, rainless lives before and human government after. Eight were saved as God called Noah into the ark. As God once destroyed the earth, He will make a new heaven and earth, and all will stand before the judgment seat. He warns against any-minute teaching.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

faqs.question: When were we redeemed?
faqs.answer: Before the foundation of the world, though Christ died 2,000 years ago.

faqs.question: Will Christians stand before the judgment seat?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Bible is clear we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And there I will meet with you, and I will speak with you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the Testimony, about everything which I will give you in commandment to the children of Israel.
